Name: Anthro Characters Continued - Furry Overhaul Mod With Optional Genderswaps
Author: sion9000
Description:
[center][b]May 2026 v11 Update:[/b] The optional Male-to-Female genderswaps for romanceable characters are complete! Say hello to Alexis, Ellen, Hannah, Sabrina, Samantha, and Shauna!

As always, if you enjoy the mod please consider supporting the creator here:
[url=https://ko-fi.com/gaveliere]https://ko-fi.com/gaveliere
[/url][url=https://ko-fi.com/gaveliere]https://ko-fi.com/gaveliere[/url]
[url=https://ko-fi.com/gaveliere]https://ko-fi.com/gaveliere[/url][/center]
[center]

[b][u]Anthro Characters Continued[/u] overhauls virtually every NPC in the game, creating a wholly re-imagined Stardew Valley experience for those who enjoy anthropomorphic animal characters.[/b] And now it is compatible with Stardew 1.6!

[b]New Winter Art![/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/5qYuNDi.png[/img]

[b]Optional genderswaps for the romanceable characters! [/b][/center]
[center]Each swap is individually toggleable in-game. Includes dialogue changes and text tweaks.[/center]
[center]Now includes 1.6 winter art!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/igpTPTy.png[/img][/center]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/k0079lp.png[/img]
(0). [url=https://help.steampowered.com/en/faqs/view/0C48-FCBD-DA71-93EB]Validate your steam game files for stardew[/url]. If you’ve EVER used a pre-1.6 version of this mod, you’ll definitely want to do this!
1. Install the most recent version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
2. Install the most recent version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
3. Install the most recent version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (Optional but recommended)
4. Install this mod by going to the downloads tab
5. Copy the contents of the .zip to your Mods directory.
6. Start the game

[b]To configure gender swaps:[/b]
1. On the title screen, assuming you have Generic Mod Config Menu installed, click the gear icon.
2. Click Anthro Characters Continued.
3. Configure to your heart's content.
4. Click "Save" at the bottom.

[b]Issues?
[/b]Before logging a bug, try [url=https://help.steampowered.com/en/faqs/view/0C48-FCBD-DA71-93EB]validating your steam game files for stardew[/url], especially if you've installed this same mod in the past.
There are still a fair number of new issues with 1.6. We'd appreciate being told of any sprites that could be anthro-ified.
[center]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/RDmZTEs.png[/img]

[b]If you enjoy the mod, please strongly consider sending a tip Gaveliere's way. Every little bit helps!
His kofi: [url=https://ko-fi.com/gaveliere]https://ko-fi.com/gaveliere
[/url][/b]

FAQ:
[b]How do I turn on genderswaps?
[/b](0). Install Generic Mod Config Menu from nexus
1. On the title screen click the gear icon.
2. Click Anthro Characters Continued.
3. Configure to your heart's content.
4. Click "Save" at the bottom.

[b]Will this break steam achievements?[/b]
No

[b]Will this corrupt my save?[/b]
No. Delete the mod and everything will go right back to normal!

[b]Is this mod compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE)?[/b]
Yes, to an extent. They don't outright conflict, but there is no official furry art by Gav for SVE [i]yet[/i].
The most up-to-date community-made SVE extension is here: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22271/]Furry Stardew Valley Expanded Continued[/url]


Github: [url=https://github.com/donedonedone278/AnthroCharacters]https://github.com/donedonedone278/AnthroCharacters
[/url]

Downloads.Description: Requires SMAPI, Content Patcher, and (Optionally) Generic Mod Config Menu. Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6.15+. Toggleable Genderswaps included.

Manifest.Name: Anthro Characters Continued
Manifest.Description: Overwrites every NPC sprite, portrait and event sprites, effectively transforming everyone into anthropormorphic animal characters. Art by Gav!
